error: ValueError: v2 dev overlaps v1 scored IDs
diagnosis: The runner excluded a v2-hash-ranked cohort instead of reproducing the frozen v1 dev allocation. The frozen v1 and v2 namespaces produce different orderings.
correction: Recompute v1 dev with SHA256('VARE-SVAMP-v1/dev:' + ID), then select v2 dev from the remaining valid rows.
